case_selection.paths: Earliest TEST instance per requested semantic category and side, elapsed >= 5 s; preserve counterexamples
case_selection.event_life: TEST event-side groups with >=12 origins and >=1 endpoint-qualified origin: earliest group with <=2 qualification flips and earliest with >=3 flips; supplemental stable case requires >=6 qualified origins and <=2 flips; no PnL ranking
case_selection.matched_pairs: TEST origins at 60s cadence; nearest geometry/price/time neighbour from another TEST day, RMS TRAIN-IQR standardized distance <=0.5; also London-clock difference <=30min, spread difference <=1 tick, max BB position difference <=0.5, max log-half difference <=0.35. Matching never reads labels; show earliest concordant-positive, discordant and concordant-negative pairs
case_selection.matching_revision: Initial visual QA found a 6-hour difference despite low RMS distance. Added explicit time and geometry calipers before final audit; predictive probe and target were not changed.

probe.target: Any endpoint-qualified first-line crossing within 300s, separately LONG and SHORT; common nine-cell maturity
probe.base: 14 frozen geometry/time/spread features plus 18 trailing price displacement/path/efficiency features (32)
probe.augmented: base plus frozen Micro depth, imbalance, trade/add/remove/matched-fill/event-count features; duplicate spread omitted (69 total)
probe.split: Reuse frozen V5 7 TRAIN / 3 validation / 5 calibration / 5 TEST days. Fit TRAIN only; no threshold or hyperparameter selection.
probe.null: At TEST only, permute flow rows within day and TRAIN-derived geometry-prediction decile. Conditional approximation, not a causal intervention.
probe.controls: Raw quote paths not inputs; source_available_ns <= decision; fixed allow-list. TEST was historically inspected; exploratory transfer, not untouched holdout.

admission: Retrospective labels, visual semantic audit and bounded predictive probe; no trading policy or PnL claim
